incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#12345 - inference.latency.p95 eu-west-1 > 1200ms
incident-bot: severity=warning; source=router-proxy; route=/v1/generate
Alex M: acked, taking it. on-call for this window.
Alex M: pulling metrics — quick query: `sum(rate(requests[1m])) by (pool), histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket[1m])) by (le,pool))`
Jamal: seeing a short CPU spike on dedicated-pool-eu-3 (host-17). ~0.6% reqs affected, p95 ~1.3s, no 5xx spikes.
Priya S: any customer-facing errors? support channels?
Jamal: none in support yet. internal canary shows higher latency for long-context models only.
Alex M: autoscaler check — cooldown not expired, but policy allowed a burst-add. triggering manual scaling to confirm.
incident-bot: Autoscaler action: scale_up +1 -> pool:dedicated-pool-eu-3; reason=cpu_spike_threshold
Diane: saw matching increase in KV cache misses during spike, might explain latency for long-context.
Alex M: forcing KV prefill on new node; tailing router logs:
```
2026-10-12T09:12:03Z router: conn=237 handler=proxy req_id=abcd1234 latency=1208ms route=/v1/generate model=long-context-v2
2026-10-12T09:12:04Z autoscaler: scale_up host=host-18 pool=dedicated-pool-eu-3
```
Priya S: pinged support w/ note, no customers reporting degraded experience :relieved:
Jamal: p95 trending down — 3 mins after scale, p95 ~320ms.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD#12345 auto-resolved (closed) — condition cleared
Alex M: follow-up: create infra ticket to reduce scale-up threshold for long-context workloads in eu-west and extend KV warmup when scaling. Will also add a short synthetic canary for long-context models.
Priya S: agreed — will loop in SRE and infra.
Diane: optional: investigate cache prefill priority and async prewarm on deploys.
Alex M: thanks all. marking thread closed :white_check_mark:
